title: Visual Merchandising Training Sign-Off Form
subtitle: A practical observed-practice training sign-off for visual merchandising that connects identity, observations and evidence, decision authority, exception ownership, and accountable closeout.
description: An original retail-operations observed-practice training sign-off for visual merchandising covering display execution and release, evidence references, authorization, escalation, operating limits, disposition, and handoff without copying a third-party form.
use_case: Use when a visual merchandising lead opens one visual merchandising record to plan instruction, observe practice, identify knowledge and authority limits, assign follow-up, and acknowledge the resulting work scope; closure requires a documented outcome, evidence route, responsible owner, and recipient acknowledgment.

sections.title: Merchandising training sign-off identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this training sign-off to one location, operating period, accountable owner, and review route.

blocks.label: Merchandising event scope, trigger, affected area, and prior handoff

fields.label: Visual Merchandising scope and routing context

sections.title: Merchandising training plan and learner route
sections.guidance: Define the procedure revision, learning method, practice setting, supervisor, and authorized scope.

blocks.label: Merchandising competencies
items: Uses the correct campaign plan and revision
Reconciles fixtures, signs, products, and materials
Records existing condition before installation
Identifies path, fixture, and powered-component concerns
Matches price, offer, and copy to approved sources
Controls substitutions and placement variances
Captures evidence without unnecessary customer data
Makes a documented zone-release decision
Briefs store staff on care and open issues
Plans removal, reuse, storage, and disposal

blocks.label: Training and authorization boundary
blocks.guidance: Do not claim accessibility, electrical, structural, promotional, or legal compliance from this visual record. Stop and restrict a display when conditions exceed current training or authorization. Avoid identifiable customer images unless genuinely required and approved. Follow applicable merchandising, safety, accessibility, privacy, and promotional policy and route judgment to the authorized reviewer. This sign-off records observed practice and assigned limits; it is not a license, professional certification, or guarantee of future performance.

sections.title: Merchandising coached practice and evidence
sections.guidance: Record the scenario, learner action, observable result, coaching, and next attempt rather than a generic pass mark.

blocks.label: Exception scenarios reviewed
items: Approved plan or material unavailable
Substitution or placement variance requested
Price, offer, or copy requires owner review
Fixture or powered component cannot be released
Customer path or operational access is affected
Campaign release or removal date must change

blocks.label: Strengths, repeated errors, prompts required, evidence references, and conditions for another observation

sections.title: Merchandising knowledge check, limits, and escalation
sections.guidance: Confirm that the learner can identify sources, stop conditions, authorization limits, escalation owners, and handoff evidence.

blocks.label: Condition and exception knowledge
items: Plan, revision, price, offer, or copy mismatch
Fixture, sign, product, or hardware missing
Damaged, unstable, sharp, powered, or obstructing component
Unapproved substitution or placement
Customer path, service access, or sightline concern
Lighting, power, screen, or content failure
Install cannot finish before release window
Removal, storage, or waste route unclear

blocks.label: Knowledge gaps, restricted tasks, retraining topics, interim supervision, and evidence needed

fields.label: Visual Merchandising knowledge gaps and limits

sections.title: Merchandising work authorization and follow-up plan
sections.guidance: Grant only the observed scope and state the supervision, expiry, reassessment, or restriction that applies.

blocks.label: Training authorization handoff
items: Readiness decision communicated to scheduler
Restricted tasks visible to supervising owner
Procedure version and practice evidence linked
Coach accepted follow-up responsibility
Reassessment date or trigger recorded
Learner can identify the escalation route

sections.title: Merchandising outcome, closeout, and handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and acceptance visible.

blocks.label: Merchandising closeout controls
items: Final campaign revision and zones recorded
Release photos and evidence references linked
Price and promotional source check completed
Open material or fixture issue assigned
Store team received care and removal notes
Removal date and storage or disposal owner assigned

blocks.label: Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Unresolved work, customer or staff impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Visual Merchandising residual work and handoff

blocks.label: Training Sign-Off closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not a legal, safety, or professional certification.
